fields.name: model
fields.help: The technical name of the model this field belongs to

fields.name: relation
fields.help: For relationship fields, the technical name of the target model

fields.name: relation_field
fields.help: For one2many fields, the field on the target model that implement the opposite many2one relationship

fields.name: model_id
fields.help: The model this field belongs to

fields.name: copied
fields.help: Whether the value is copied when duplicating a record.

fields.name: related
fields.help: The corresponding related field, if any. This must be a dot-separated list of field names.

fields.name: translate
fields.help: Whether values for this field can be translated (enables the translation mechanism for that field)

fields.name: company_dependent
fields.help: Whether values for this field is company dependent

fields.name: on_delete
fields.help: On delete property for many2one fields

fields.name: domain
fields.help: The optional domain to restrict possible values for relationship fields, specified as a Python expression defining a list of triplets. For example: [('color','=','red')]

fields.name: group_expand
fields.help:
If checked, all the records of the target model will be included
in a grouped result (e.g. 'Group By' filters, Kanban columns, etc.).
Note that it can significantly reduce performance if the target model
of the field contains a lot of records; usually used on models with
few records (e.g. Stages, Job Positions, Event Types, etc.).

fields.name: modules
fields.help: List of modules in which the field is defined

fields.name: relation_table
fields.help: Used for custom many2many fields to define a custom relation table name

fields.name: column1
fields.help: Column referring to the record in the model table

fields.name: column2
fields.help: Column referring to the record in the comodel table

fields.name: compute
fields.help:
Code to compute the value of the field.
Iterate on the recordset 'self' and assign the field's value:

    for record in self:
        record['size'] = len(record.name)

Modules time, datetime, dateutil are available.

fields.name: depends
fields.help:
Dependencies of compute method; a list of comma-separated field names, like

    name, partner_id.name

fields.name: store
fields.help: Whether the value is stored in the database.

fields.name: currency_field
fields.help: Name of the Many2one field holding the res.currency

fields.name: tracking
fields.help: If set every modification done to this field is tracked. Value is used to order tracking values.

fields.name: serialization_field_id
fields.help: If set, this field will be stored in the sparse structure of the serialization field, instead of having its own database column. This cannot be changed after creation.

fields.name: website_form_blacklisted
fields.help: Blacklist this field for web forms

constraints.name: _name_unique
constraints.message: Field names must be unique per model.

constraints.name: _size_gt_zero
constraints.message: Size of the field cannot be negative.

constraints.name: _name_manual_field
constraints.message: Custom fields must have a name that starts with 'x_'!

Return the (sudoed) `ir.model.fields` record with the given model and name.
The result may be an empty recordset if the model is not found.

Check whether the fields in `self` may be modified or removed.
This method prevents the modification/deletion of many2one fields
that have an inverse one2many, for instance.

definitions.documentation:
When unlinking fields populate tracking value table with relevant
information. That way if a field is removed (custom tracked, migration
or any other reason) we keep the tracking and its relevant information.
Do it only when unlinking fields so that we don't duplicate field
information for most tracking.
